name: dev7: final-test filter with a larger safety margin (h_safe = log2 3) vs final-test filter (h_safe = 1), 600 episodes, Rorqual
written: 2026-10-16 ~03:15, before any dev7 episode was run
motivation: Of the 78 topples the final-test filter did not prevent in dev6, 53 had the filter act within 3 decisions before the topple (41 at the topple decision itself): detected but too late. One decision earlier the barrier often read h = 1.0 (no fork at normal error, fork at 2x), which h_safe = 1 accepts. Requiring h >= min(h_now, log2 3) acts on those marginal plans one step earlier.
setting: as the final test; all three arms of an episode in one cluster job; model_US

arms.cbfm: same filter with h_safe = log2(3); everything else unchanged

decision_rule: cbfm goes to a fresh pre-registered final test if it has at least 4 fewer topples than cbf AND success >= cbf success - 8. 1-3 fewer with success within 8: 'not distinguishable', decide with the user. Otherwise keep the final-test filter. dev7 numbers are never reported as a test result.
